rationale: The continuation-short thesis (below VWAP and 9-EMA on heavy volume) has produced no follow-through in 30 minutes — price is stalled right on the 9-EMA ($17.37), MFE was just 0.06%, and the last five 1m candles are flat with light volume, indicating seller momentum has faded rather than extended.
